verdict.rationale: Bolna documents a Tools tab where ready-to-use tools can be enabled on a voice agent, and tools are listed as a connectable integration category. That supports in-agent tool use in principle, but the evidence never shows custom functions or arbitrary external API calls made during a live conversation. The API calls in Workflows are steps in outreach sequences, not mid-call function calls, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented custom function or external API calling mid-conversation, speaking tool results back, filler or latency handling to avoid dead air, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, my agent can call external APIs and custom functions mid-conversation and speak the result without awkward dead air

citations.quote: Bolna provides ready-to-use tools for common voice agent workflows. Click **+ Add** next to any tool to enable it for your agent.
Every provider you can bring to Bolna — telephony, LLM, TTS, STT and tools — is connected from a single place in the dashboard
